entries.question: I need to book appointment in opd
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   **Official Portal:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). 
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose your department, date, and time slot → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store, register with your mobile number, and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a booking confirmation.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   You can visit the registration counters at the hospital. 
*   **Requirements:** You must carry the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number. 
*   **Process:** Provide your details at the counter → Receive an OTP on your phone → Pay the ₹50 fee → Collect your physical OPD slip.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Mandatory:** Online registration is strongly encouraged to avoid long wait times.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Timing:** OPD registration counters are open Mon–Fri (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Sat (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Safety:** Please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat. If you have medical concerns, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333.

**Steps for Surgical Admission:**
1.  **OPD Consultation:** You must first visit the relevant department's OPD (e.g., Surgery, Orthopedics, Urology, etc.). You can book an appointment via [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) or by calling 0522-2258880.
2.  **Clinical Evaluation:** The consultant doctor will examine the patient and, if surgery is required, will provide an admission note or surgical advice.
3.  **Admission Process:** Once the doctor advises surgery, you will be guided to the department's ward or the admission counter to complete the necessary paperwork and schedule the procedure.

entries.question: न्यू ऑर्थो बिल्डिंग डॉली गंज वाले को ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन में क्या लिखेंगे
entries.answer:
ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन (ORS) करते समय, यदि आप ऑर्थोपेडिक्स (हड्डी रोग) विभाग के लिए अपॉइंटमेंट लेना चाहते हैं, तो आपको विभाग की सूची में **"Orthopaedic Surgery"** चुनना होगा। 

कृपया ध्यान दें:
1. **विभाग का चयन:** ऑनलाइन पोर्टल (www.ors.gov.in) पर 'Department' के विकल्प में 'Orthopaedic Surgery' सर्च करें और उसे चुनें।
2. **स्थान:** केजीएमयू में ऑर्थोपेडिक्स विभाग की ओपीडी मुख्य रूप से शाहमीना रोड स्थित परिसर में संचालित होती है।
3. **पंजीकरण:** ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन के बाद आपको ₹50 का शुल्क जमा करना होगा और अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड करनी होगी।

यदि आप किसी विशिष्ट डॉक्टर या ओपीडी रूम नंबर के बारे में जानना चाहते हैं, तो कृपया स्पष्ट करें। साथ ही, अपनी स्वास्थ्य संबंधी जानकारी साझा न करें। यदि आपको कोई चिकित्सीय समस्या है, तो कृपया केजीएमयू ओपीडी में जाकर डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

entries.question: अभिषेक सैनी सर
entries.answer:
डॉ. अभिषेक सैनी, ऑर्थोपेडिक्स विभाग में असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर हैं। उनके बारे में जानकारी निम्नलिखित है:

* **विभाग:** ऑर्थोपेडिक सर्जरी (Orthopaedic Surgery)
* **विशेषज्ञता:** शोल्डर आर्थ्रोस्कोपी (Shoulder Arthroscopy), रिवीज़न आर्थ्रोस्कोपी (Revision Arthroscopy)
* **संपर्क ईमेल:** abhisheksaini1034@kgmcindia.edu

यदि आप उनसे परामर्श लेना चाहते हैं, तो आपको **'Orthopaedic Surgery'** विभाग के अंतर्गत ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट (www.ors.gov.in) लेना होगा। 

**महत्वपूर्ण:** मैं एक एआई सहायक हूँ और चिकित्सा संबंधी सलाह नहीं दे सकता। यदि आप किसी स्वास्थ्य समस्या से जूझ रहे हैं, तो कृपया केजीएमयू ओपीडी (OPD) में जाकर संबंधित डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। कृपया अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी यहाँ साझा न करें।

entries.question: Research projects for me
entries.answer:
If you are a student or researcher looking for opportunities at KGMU, you can explore various research projects and academic resources through the following channels:

*   **Centre for Advanced Research (CFAR):** This is a primary hub for advanced research activities at the university. You can find more information here: [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=91&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=91&dept_type=2)
*   **DHR Multidisciplinary Research Unit (MRU):** The MRU focuses on multidisciplinary research and is located at the Kalam Centre. You can explore their ongoing work at [https://kgmudhrmru.in/](https://kgmudhrmru.in/).
*   **Departmental Research:** Most departments at KGMU conduct specific research projects. You can visit the [Departments page](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php) to identify a department relevant to your interest and contact the faculty members listed there to inquire about potential research opportunities or ongoing projects.
*   **Notice Board:** Keep an eye on the official [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) for announcements regarding research positions, project fellowships, or clinical trial recruitments.
*   **E-Library:** You can access research papers, journals, and academic databases through the [KGMU E-Library](http://elibrary.kgmu.org/) to support your literature review and project development.

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav. Please let me know if you have a specific medical specialty or field of study in mind, and I can direct you to the relevant department.

entries.question: Mri rate
entries.answer:
The rate for an MRI at KGMU ranges from **₹100 to ₹5,500**, depending on the specific type of scan and the body part involved.

For a detailed breakdown of costs, you can refer to the official rate list here: [https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm)
